This is incomplete reproducible final delivery; it does not prove the two checks were never executed. Required procedures/results and separate lead access cannot be recovered from the standalone selected final.

S5 capture path/SHA256 uses a32-hex identifier instead of the64-hex response-body digest. Independently retrieved tagged test hashes to3441d1843c49682f99bdad2cd06499a2784e74feaa803b0bbfeb40ee7bb9ea1e, also correctly printed in the proposal. Local catalog reproducibility defect, not a fabricated test chain.

The primary issue Environment header names napari0.9.1; the plugin entry names0.6.1rc1.dev1. Final abbreviates only the plugin value as the environment. Neither is the selected0.6.5 stack, so the cautious performance inference remains valid.
